description.value: Dachi is a refined farm-to-table neighbourhood restaurant on East Hastings Street, earning Platinum recognition at the Vancouver International Wine Festival for its curated selection of natural wines and craft sake. The menu rotates seasonally around local and organic ingredients, served in a warm dining room and a spacious outdoor patio that can accommodate groups up to 50 in summer. Cyclists finishing a ride through East Vancouver would find an upscale yet relaxed setting well suited to a celebratory dinner.
